Settling misses by 12% (41.8 ns vs 32 ns), and every other spec passes. The topology is fine; the large step is mostly slew-limited by Itail/Cc.

The plan is to lower Cc and raise Itail to get more slew rate. Raising kz pushes the LHP zero onto p2 to recover the phase margin that a higher UGBW costs. I6 comes down slightly to stay within the 380 µW power limit.
